verdict.rationale: Fathom has a documented REST API with TypeScript and Python SDKs, OAuth, webhooks and an official MCP server. Documented endpoints cover listing meetings, fetching transcripts and summaries, requesting recording downloads, and listing users and permissions. That reads as a mostly read-oriented data API. The UI-side features on the pricing and home pages (CRM field sync, Deal View, coaching scorecards, clips and playlists, comments, folders, keyword alerts, custom summaries, bot configuration) have no matching API endpoints in the evidence, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. Missing for 10: API coverage of collaboration features (comments, folders, playlists, clips), CRM sync, coaching and scorecards, keyword alerts, custom summaries, write or configuration actions such as recording and bot settings, and a published OpenAPI spec showing UI parity.
